can: Consigo falar de comunicação no trabalho, dar ênfase e suavizar o que digo e dar e receber feedback.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Communication at work (deadline, workload, feedback, agenda, collaborate, supervisor, appraisal, promotion, resign, overtime, team player).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: We must meet the deadline on Friday.
My workload has doubled this month.
We collaborate with the design team.
Please talk to your line manager first.
My annual appraisal is next week.
She got a promotion after two years.
He resigned to start his own business.
pessoa que trabalha bem em equipe
We need a real team player.

items: **meet / miss** a deadline; **hand in** a report; **catch up on** work
**attend / chair** a meeting; **set up** a meeting; **call off** a meeting
**be in charge of**, **report to**, **work as part of a team**
"Thanks for your feedbacks." **Feedback** é incontável: **Thanks for your feedback** (ou *comments*).
"I have a meeting with my chief." Para chefe, diga **manager** ou **boss**: **I have a meeting with my manager.**
"I'll make a reunion." **Reunion** é encontro de turma. Para reunião: **I'll hold / set up a meeting.**
"I did hour extra." O certo é **I worked overtime.**

lessons.title: Frases de ênfase (cleft) e hedging
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: cleft sentences (what / it ... that / the reason why) para dar ênfase e hedging (seems, tends to, to some extent) para suavizar.

head: Estrutura
Uso
Exemplo
rows: enfatizar o que se quer ou precisa
What I need is more time.
All I want is a clear answer.
It was Maria who suggested the idea.
The reason why I called is that the report is late.
What worries me is that nobody has answered.
The project seems to be behind schedule.
to some extent / in general / as far as I know
As far as I know, the meeting is at ten.
a bit / sort of / I'd say
It's sort of confusing, I'd say.

items: Na frase com **What ... is**, o verbo **is** é obrigatório: *What I need is...* (não *What I need it's...*).
Para dar uma crítica ou notícia ruim no trabalho, o **hedging** deixa a frase menos agressiva: *It seems that there may be a small problem* em vez de *You made an error.*
**It was ... that** pode enfatizar tempo ou lugar: *It was last week that the problem started.*
"What I need it's more time." O certo é **What I need is more time.**
"The reason why I'm calling it's that..." O certo é **The reason why I'm calling is that...**
"It was Maria that suggested" é aceitável, mas para pessoas **who** é mais natural: **It was Maria who suggested the idea.**
"You are wrong." no trabalho soa duro. Prefira **I think there may be a mistake here.**

exercises.prompt: All I ___ is a clear answer.

What I need it's more time to finish.

exercises.show: I think there may be a mistake in the figures

lessons.title: Inglês prático, dar e receber feedback
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Dar e receber feedback.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Could I give you some feedback? / Do you have a minute to talk about the report?
You did a great job with... / I really liked the way you...
One thing that could be improved is... / It might be even better if...
For example, in the second slide...
Thank you for pointing that out. / That's useful to know.
I see it a bit differently. Could I explain why?
I'll work on that and send you a new version by Thursday.

items: "I have a feedback for you." Incontável: **I have some feedback for you.**
"Your work is bad." é duro e vago. Prefira **One thing that could be improved is the structure.**
"I will do my best to improve it" é bom. Mas **I'll work on that** é mais natural para combinar uma ação.

exercises.prompt: Could I give you some ___ on your presentation?
You did a great ___ with the report.
One thing that could be ___ is the structure.
I have a feedback for you.
acc: I have some feedback for you

exercises.instr: Aponte, com tato, que a estrutura pode melhorar.
exercises.show: One thing that could be improved is the structure

exercises.prompt: Escreva 3 frases para dar um feedback construtivo a um colega.
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.

chat.scenario: Você dá feedback a um colega sobre uma apresentação e depois recebe feedback sobre o seu relatório.
chat.role: Colega aberto a feedback, que também comenta o seu trabalho.
chat.goal: Elogiar, apontar uma melhoria com tato, agradecer um comentário recebido e combinar os próximos passos.

en.vocab: Communication at work (feedback, deadline, appraisal, collaborate, team player). Key terms: could I give you some feedback, one thing that could be improved, thank you for pointing that out, I'll work on that.
